queries.sqlStatement: SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, CAST([SS].[CAS] AS DATE), 126) AS [Date], [SS].[UZIVATEL] AS [UserId], [SS].[MODUL] as [Module], [SS].[TYP] AS [UserType], [SS].[PersonID] AS [PersonId], COUNT([SS].[TYP]) as [Count] FROM (SELECT [UZIVATEL], [MODUL], [TYP], [CAS], [PersonID], DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST([CAS] AS DATE)) AS [dense] FROM (SELECT [UZIVATEL], [MODUL], [TYP], [CAS], [PersonID] FROM [weblog] UNION ALL SELECT [USER_CODE] AS [UZIVATEL], 'D' AS [MODUL], 'U' AS [TYP], CAST(STUFF(STUFF([LOGIN], 11, 0, ' : '), 9, 0,' ') AS DATETIME) AS [CAS], null AS [PersonID] FROM [bakusers]) AS [weblog] WHERE [CAS] >= '20260511' AND [CAS] < DATEADD(DAY, -1, cast(SYSDATETIME() AS DATE))) AS [SS] WHERE [dense] < 21 GROUP BY CONVERT(VARCHAR, CAST([SS].[CAS] AS DATE), 126), [SS].[UZIVATEL], [SS].[MODUL], [SS].[TYP], [SS].[PersonID]
queries.columnsNames: Date, UserId, Module, UserType, PersonId, Count

queries.sqlStatement: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY [Date]) AS [dense] FROM ( SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, (CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)), 126) AS [SampleDate], CASE WHEN ISNULL([S_Spoj].[s_den], '') = '' THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR, (CONVERT(DATE, SUBSTRING([R_Spoj].[r_den], 1, 4) + '-' + SUBSTRING([R_Spoj].[r_den], 5, 2) + '-' + SUBSTRING([R_Spoj].[r_den], 7, 2))), 126) ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR, (CONVERT(DATE, SUBSTRING([S_Spoj].[s_den], 1, 4) + '-' + SUBSTRING([S_Spoj].[s_den], 5, 2) + '-' + SUBSTRING([S_Spoj].[s_den], 7, 2))), 126) END AS [Date], CASE WHEN ISNULL([S_Spoj].[s_hod], 0) = 0 THEN [R_Spoj].[r_hod] ELSE [S_Spoj].[s_hod] END AS [Lesson], [S_Spoj].[s_ucit] AS [RealTeacher], [S_Spoj].[s_mist] AS [RealRoom], [S_Spoj].[s_pred] AS [RealSubject], [S_Spoj].[s_spoj] AS [RealGroup], [S_Spoj].[ZMENA_TYP] AS [ChangeType], [R_Spoj].[r_ucit] AS [OrgTeacher], [R_Spoj].[r_mist] AS [OrgRoom], [R_Spoj].[r_pred] AS [OrgSubject], [R_Spoj].[r_spoj] AS [OrgGroup] FROM (SELECT [S].[DEN] AS [s_den], [S].[HOD] AS [s_hod], [S].[KOD_UCIT] AS [s_ucit], [S].[KOD_MIST] AS [s_mist], [S].[KOD_PRED] AS [s_pred], [S].[SPOJ_UVAZ] AS [s_spoj], [S].[ZMENA_TYP] FROM [s_rozvrh] AS [S] WHERE [S].[DEN] != '' AND CONVERT(DATETIME, [S].[DEN], 126) >= DATEADD(DAY, -7, '20260919') AND CONVERT(DATETIME, [S].[DEN], 126) < DATEADD(DAY, -7, DATEADD(DAY, -1, cast(SYSDATETIME() AS DATE))) AND [S].[SPOJ_UVAZ] != '0' GROUP BY [S].[DEN], [S].[HOD], [S].[KOD_UCIT], [S].[KOD_MIST], [S].[KOD_PRED], [S].[SPOJ_UVAZ], [S].[ZMENA_TYP]) AS [S_Spoj] FULL JOIN (SELECT [R].[DEN] AS [r_den], [R].[HOD] AS [r_hod], [R].[KOD_UCIT] AS [r_ucit], [R].[KOD_MIST] AS [r_mist], [R].[KOD_PRED] AS [r_pred], [R].[SPOJ_UVAZ] AS [r_spoj] FROM [r_rozvrh] AS [R] WHERE [R].[DEN] != '' AND CONVERT(DATETIME, [R].[DEN], 126) >= DATEADD(DAY, -7, '20260919') AND CONVERT(DATETIME, [R].[DEN], 126) < DATEADD(DAY, -7, DATEADD(DAY, -1, cast(SYSDATETIME() AS DATE))) AND [R].[SPOJ_UVAZ] != '0' GROUP BY [R].[DEN], [R].[HOD], [R].[KOD_UCIT], [R].[KOD_MIST], [R].[KOD_PRED], [R].[SPOJ_UVAZ]) AS [R_Spoj] ON [S_Spoj].[s_den] = [R_Spoj].[r_den] AND [S_Spoj].[s_hod] = R_Spoj.[r_hod] WHERE CASE WHEN ISNULL([S_Spoj].[s_den], '') = '' THEN CONVERT(DATETIME, [R_Spoj].[r_den], 126) ELSE CONVERT(DATETIME, [S_Spoj].[s_den], 126) END >= DATEADD(DAY, -7, '20260919') AND CASE WHEN ISNULL([S_Spoj].[s_den], '') = '' THEN CONVERT(DATETIME, [R_Spoj].[r_den], 126) ELSE CONVERT(DATETIME, [S_Spoj].[s_den], 126) END < DATEADD(DAY, -7, DATEADD(DAY, -1, cast(SYSDATETIME() AS DATE))) UNION ALL SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, (CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)), 126) AS [SampleDate], CASE WHEN ISNULL([S].[DEN], '') = '' THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR, (CONVERT(DATE, SUBSTRING([R].[DEN], 1, 4) + '-' + SUBSTRING([R].[DEN], 5, 2) + '-' + SUBSTRING([R].[DEN], 7, 2))), 126) ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR, (CONVERT(DATE, SUBSTRING([S].[DEN], 1, 4) + '-' + SUBSTRING([S].[DEN], 5, 2) + '-' + SUBSTRING([S].[DEN], 7, 2))), 126) END AS [Date], CASE WHEN ISNULL([S].[HOD], 0) = 0 THEN [R].[HOD] ELSE [S].[HOD] END AS [Lesson], [S].[KOD_UCIT] AS [s_ucit], [S].[KOD_MIST] AS [s_mist], [S].[kod_pred] AS [s_pred], [S].[SPOJ_UVAZ] AS [s_spoj], [S].[ZMENA_TYP], [R].[KOD_UCIT] AS [r_ucit], [R].[KOD_MIST] AS [r_mist], [R].[KOD_PRED] AS [r_pred], [R].[SPOJ_UVAZ] AS [r_spoj] FROM [s_rozvrh] AS [S] FULL JOIN [r_rozvrh] AS [R] ON [S].[DEN] = [R].[DEN] AND [S].[hod] = [R].[hod] AND [S].[KOD_TRID] = [R].[KOD_TRID] AND [S].[KOD_SKUP] = [R].[KOD_SKUP] WHERE CASE WHEN ISNULL([S].[DEN], '') = '' THEN CONVERT(DATETIME, [R].[DEN], 126) ELSE CONVERT(DATETIME, [S].[DEN], 126) END >= DATEADD(DAY, -7, '20260919') AND CASE WHEN ISNULL([S].[DEN], '') = '' THEN CONVERT(DATETIME, [R].[DEN], 126) ELSE CONVERT(DATETIME, [S].[DEN], 126) END < DATEADD(DAY, -7, DATEADD(DAY, -1, cast(SYSDATETIME() AS DATE))) AND [S].[SPOJ_UVAZ] = '0' ) as Substitution ) AS [Data] WHERE [dense] < 21

queries.sqlStatement: SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, [Data].[SampleDate], 126) AS [SampleDate], [Data].[InsertedBy], [Data].[DocumentId], [Data].[MovementType], [Data].[ClassId], [Data].[SumAmount], [Data].[MinAmount], [Data].[MaxAmount], [Data].[RowsCount], [Data].[Period] FROM ( SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY [SampleDate]) AS [dense] FROM ( SELECT CAST([D].[Modified] AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'CENTRAL EUROPEAN STANDARD TIME' AS DATE) AS [SampleDate], [D].[InsertedBy], [D].[DocumentId], [D].[MovementType], [T].[KOD_TRID] AS [ClassId], SUM([D].[Amount]) AS [SumAmount], MIN([D].[Amount]) AS [MinAmount], MAX([D].[Amount]) AS [MaxAmount], COUNT(*) AS [RowsCount], SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR, CAST([D].[Inserted] AS DATE), 126), 1, 7) AS [Period] FROM [Payments].[DocumentLine] AS [D] LEFT JOIN [Payments].[PersonAccount] AS [P] ON [D].[PersonAccountId] = [P].[Id] LEFT JOIN [zaci] AS [Z] ON [P].[PersonId] = [Z].[INTERN_KOD] LEFT JOIN [tridy] AS [T] ON [Z].[TRIDA] = [T].[ZKRATKA] GROUP BY CAST([D].[Modified] AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'CENTRAL EUROPEAN STANDARD TIME' AS DATE), SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR, CAST([D].[Inserted] AS DATE), 126), 1, 7), [D].[InsertedBy], [D].[DocumentId], [D].[MovementType], [T].[KOD_TRID] ) as DocumentLine WHERE [SampleDate] >= '20250901' AND [SampleDate] < DATEADD(DAY, -1, cast(SYSDATETIME() AS DATE)) ) AS [Data] WHERE [dense] < 21
queries.columnsNames: SampleDate, InsertedBy, DocumentId, MovementType, ClassId, SumAmount, MinAmount, MaxAmount, RowsCount, Period

queries.sqlStatement: SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, (CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)), 126) AS [SampleDate], [InsertedBy], MAX(LEN([Title])) AS [MaxTitleLength], MAX([Amount]) AS [MaxAmount], MIN([Amount]) AS [MinAmount], MAX([RestOfRounding]) AS [MaxRestOfRounding], MIN([RestOfRounding]) AS [MinRestOfRounding], COUNT(1) AS [NumOfDocuments], [Discriminator], [PaymentTypeId], [State], CAST(CASE WHEN ISNULL([BankMoveId], 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS BIT) AS [IsFromBankMove], MAX(DATEDIFF(DAY, [Inserted], DATE)) AS [MaxDifferenceBetweenInsertedAndDay], MIN(DATEDIFF(DAY, [Inserted], DATE)) AS [MinDifferenceBetweenInsertedAndDay] FROM [Payments].[Document] WHERE CAST([Inserted] AS DATE) >= DATEADD(DAY, -7, CAST('20240910' AS DATE)) AND CAST([Inserted] AS DATE) < DATEADD(DAY, -7, CAST('20241001' AS DATE)) GROUP BY [InsertedBy], [Discriminator], [PaymentTypeId], [State], CASE WHEN ISNULL([BankMoveId], 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
queries.columnsNames: SampleDate, InsertedBy, MaxTitleLength, MaxAmount, MinAmount, MaxRestOfRounding, MinRestOfRounding, NumOfDocuments, Discriminator, PaymentTypeId, State, IsFromBankMove, MaxDifferenceBetweenInsertedAndDay, MinDifferenceBetweenInsertedAndDay

queries.sqlStatement: SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, (CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)), 126) AS [SampleDate], [RAW_DATA].[Period], [RAW_DATA].[ConsentId], [RAW_DATA].[ConsentState], [RAW_DATA].[ClassId], [RAW_DATA].[UserType], [RAW_DATA].[UserTypeAgreed], COUNT(*) AS [NumberOfItems] FROM (SELECT SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR, CAST([R].[Inserted] AS DATE), 126), 1, 7) AS [Period], [R].[ConsentId], [R].[ConsentState], [T].[KOD_TRID] AS [ClassId], [R].[UserType], [R].[UserTypeAgreed] FROM [Gdpr].[ConsentRecipient] AS [R] LEFT JOIN [dbo].[zaci] AS [Z] ON [R].[InternKod] = [Z].[INTERN_KOD] LEFT JOIN [dbo].[tridy] AS [T] ON [Z].[TRIDA] = [T].[ZKRATKA] WHERE CAST([R].[Inserted] AS DATE) >= DATEADD(MONTH, -1, CAST('20240910' AS DATE)) AND CAST([R].[Inserted] AS DATE) < DATEADD(MONTH, -1, CAST('20241001' AS DATE))) AS [RAW_DATA] GROUP BY [RAW_DATA].[Period], [RAW_DATA].[ConsentId], [RAW_DATA].[ConsentState], [RAW_DATA].[ClassId], [RAW_DATA].[UserType], [RAW_DATA].[UserTypeAgreed]

[SubjectLenght],        [IsAnswer],        [OldKomens],        [IsHomeworkId],        [Discriminator],        [SenderHidden],        [Class],        [RecipientType],        [NumberOfItems] FROM END AS BIT) AS [SenderHidden],              CASE                  WHEN ISNULL([T_Z].[KOD_TRID], '') = '' THEN [T].[KOD_TRID]                  ELSE [T_Z].[KOD_TRID]              END AS [Class], queries.sqlStatement: SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, (CAST(Getdate() AS DATE)), 126) AS [SampleDate], CONVERT(VARCHAR, [Date], 126) AS [Date], [PersonType], [Type], MAX(MaxSize) AS [MaxSize], [OldKomens], [Class], MAX([NumberOfItems]) AS [MaxFilesOnMessage], SUM([NumberOfItems]) AS [NumberOfFiles], COUNT(*) AS [NumberOfMessages] FROM (SELECT CAST([F].[Inserted] AS DATE) AS [Date],  LEFT([F].[InsertedBy], 1) AS [PersonType], [F].[MessageId], [F].[Type], MAX([F].[Size]) AS [MaxSize], CAST(CASE WHEN ISNULL([F].[OldMessageId], '') != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS [OldKomens], CASE WHEN ISNULL([T_Z].[KOD_TRID], '') = '' THEN [T].[KOD_TRID] ELSE [T_Z].[KOD_TRID] END AS [Class], COUNT(*) AS [NumberOfItems] FROM [Komens].[File] AS [F] LEFT JOIN [zaci] AS [Z] ON SUBSTRING([F].[InsertedBy], 2, 6) = [Z].[INTERN_KOD] LEFT JOIN [tridy] AS [T] ON SUBSTRING([F].[InsertedBy], 2, 6) = [T].[TRIDNICTVI] LEFT JOIN [tridy] AS [T_Z] ON [Z].[TRIDA] = [T_Z].[ZKRATKA] WHERE [F].[Inserted] >= '20220316' AND [F].[Inserted] < '20220401' GROUP BY CAST([F].[Inserted] AS DATE), LEFT([F].[InsertedBy], 1), [F].[MessageId], [F].[Type], CASE WHEN ISNULL([F].[OldMessageId], '') != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN ISNULL([T_Z].[KOD_TRID], '') = '' THEN [T].[KOD_TRID] ELSE [T_Z].[KOD_TRID] END) AS [RAW_DATA] GROUP BY [Date], [PersonType], [Type], [OldKomens], [Class]
queries.columnsNames: SampleDate, Date, PersonType, Type, MaxSize, OldKomens, Class, MaxFilesOnMessage, NumberOfFiles, NumberOfMessages

queries.sqlStatement: SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, (CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)), 126) AS [SampleDate], CAST([name] AS NVARCHAR) AS [LogicalName], REPLACE([physical_name], '\', '\\') AS [PhysicalName], CAST([size] / 1024 * 8 AS INT) AS [SizeInMB], CAST(CASE WHEN [max_size] > 0 THEN [max_size] / 1024 * 8 ELSE [max_size] END AS INT) AS [MaxSizeInMB], CAST(CAST([size] / 1024 * 8 AS INT) - CAST(FILEPROPERTY([name], 'SpaceUsed') / 1024 * 8 AS INT) AS INT) AS [EmptySpaceInMB], [type_desc] AS [TypeDescription] FROM [sys].[database_files] WHERE [state] = 0

queries.sqlStatement: IF EXISTS(SELECT 1          FROM sys.schemas s               JOIN sys.tables t ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id               JOIN sys.columns c ON t.object_id = c.object_id          WHERE COL_LENGTH('dbo.zaci', 'ISIC_CIP')   is not null and 			    COL_LENGTH('dbo.zaci', 'ISIC_KARTA') is not null and			    COL_LENGTH('dbo.zaci', 'ISIC_OBJDT') is not null and		    COL_LENGTH('dbo.zaci', 'ISIC_PLAT')  is not null and			    COL_LENGTH('dbo.zaci', 'ISIC_TYP')   is not null  )     EXEC sys.sp_executesql N'select CONVERT(VARCHAR, (CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)), 126) AS [SampleDate],''Z'' as UserType, [INTERN_KOD] AS [PersonId], [ISIC_CIP] as [IsicChip], [ISIC_KARTA] as [IsicCard], CONVERT(VARCHAR, [ISIC_OBJDT], 126) AS [IsicOrderDate], [ISIC_PLAT] as [IsicValidity], [ISIC_TYP] as [IsicType] from zaci where isnull(ISIC_CIP,'''') != '''' OR isnull(ISIC_KARTA,'''') != '''' OR isnull(ISIC_OBJDT,'''') != '''' OR isnull(ISIC_PLAT,'''') != '''' OR isnull(ISIC_TYP,'''') != '''' union select CONVERT(VARCHAR, (CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)), 126) AS [SampleDate],''U'' as UserType, [INTERN_KOD] AS [PersonId], [ISIC_CIP] as [IsicChip], [ISIC_KARTA] as [IsicCard], CONVERT(VARCHAR, [ISIC_OBJDT], 126) AS [IsicOrderDate], [ISIC_PLAT] as [IsicValidity], [ISIC_TYP] as [IsicType] from ucitele where isnull(ISIC_CIP,'''') != '''' OR isnull(ISIC_KARTA,'''') != '''' OR isnull(ISIC_OBJDT,'''') != '''' OR isnull(ISIC_PLAT,'''') != '''' OR isnull(ISIC_TYP,'''') != '''' ;'; ELSE    EXEC sys.sp_executesql N'select top 0 null as SampleDate, null as UserType, null as PersonId, null as IsicChip, null as IsicCard, null as IsicOrderDate, null as IsicValidity, null as IsicType ;';
queries.columnsNames: SampleDate, UserType, PersonId, IsicChip, IsicCard, IsicOrderDate, IsicValidity, IsicType

queries.description: Sběr dat - BKMEM - posbírat způsob tvorby loginů z PUBLIC.INI
queries.sqlStatement: /* parsovani ini, inspirace: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/76003486/parse-a-long-text-string-of-the-ini-file-stored-in-a-cell-of-the-sql-server-tabl */ WITH T AS( /* Sběr dat - BKMEM - posbírat způsob tvorby loginů z PUBLIC.INI */ SELECT 'public.ini' as IniSource, CONCAT('[', value) AS VAL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY value) AS ORD FROM STRING_SPLIT ((REPLACE(CAST ((SELECT MEMTEXT FROM bkmem WHERE nazev LIKE '%public.ini') AS NVARCHAR (MAX)), ' ', CHAR(13) + CHAR(10))), '[') WHERE value <> '' UNION ALL /* 83116 - Sběr dat bkmem ZACI.INI */ SELECT 'zaci.ini' as IniSource, CONCAT('[', value) AS VAL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY value) AS ORD FROM STRING_SPLIT(CAST(( SELECT TOP 1 MEMTEXT FROM bkmem WHERE nazev LIKE '%\zaci.ini') AS nvarchar(MAX)), '[') WHERE value <> ''), S AS (SELECT IniSource, LEFT(VAL, CHARINDEX(']', VAL)) AS Section, SUBSTRING(VAL, CHARINDEX(']', VAL) + 3, LEN(VAL) - CHARINDEX(']', VAL)) AS K FROM T) SELECT CONVERT (VARCHAR, (CAST (GETDATE() AS DATE)), 126) AS [SampleDate], [Section], /* IIF check, aby nespadl LEFT atd v pripade nenalezeni casti pred nebo za rovnitkem */ LTRIM(RTRIM(LEFT(value, IIF (CHARINDEX('=', value) > 0, CHARINDEX('=', value), 1) - 1))) AS [Key], LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(value, IIF (CHARINDEX('=', value) > 0, CHARINDEX('=', value), -1) + 1, 1000))) AS [Value] FROM S CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT (K, CHAR(10)) as X WHERE /* seznam sekci+klice v ini souboru, ktere chceme sledovat */ /* Sběr dat - BKMEM - posbírat způsob tvorby loginů z PUBLIC.INI */ ( IniSource = 'public.ini' AND ( (Section = '[BakaWEB]' AND (value LIKE 'loginRodic=%' OR value LIKE 'loginZaci=%' OR value LIKE 'loginUcit=%' OR value LIKE 'loginDohled=%')) OR (Section = '[Evid]' AND (value LIKE 'slozitostHesla=%')) ) ) OR ( /* 83116 - Sběr dat bkmem ZACI.INI */ IniSource = 'zaci.ini' and NULLIF(ltrim(rtrim(REPLACE(value, CHAR(13), ''))), '') IS NOT NULL /* nemam vracet prazdne klice */ );
queries.columnsNames: SampleDate, Section, Key, Value

queries.sqlStatement: SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR,(Cast(Getdate() AS DATE)), 126) AS [SampleDate] , LEFT(Isnull(s.value, ''), 5) AS newpaymentsisenabled, p.paymentprescriptionminyear, p.paymentprescriptionmaxyear, z.paymentminyear, z.paymentmaxyear , x.originpaymentsisenabled FROM( SELECT isnull(try_cast(Min(Substring(plat_do, 1, 4)) as int), 0) AS paymentprescriptionminyear, isnull(try_cast(max(substring(plat_do, 1, 4)) AS int), 0) AS paymentprescriptionmaxyear FROM dbskklnd) p CROSS JOIN ( SELECT isnull(min(year(datum)),0) AS paymentminyear, isnull(max(year(datum)),0) AS paymentmaxyear FROM zaciskol) z CROSS JOIN ( SELECT count(1) as originpaymentsisenabled FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'zaci' AND COLUMN_NAME in ('S1_','SD1_','P1_','PD1_','K1_') ) as X LEFT JOIN appsettings s ON s.module = 'Payments' AND s.parameter = 'Payments.IsEnabled'
queries.columnsNames: SampleDate, NewPaymentsIsEnabled, PaymentPrescriptionMinYear, PaymentPrescriptionMaxYear, PaymentMinYear, PaymentMaxYear, OriginPaymentsIsEnabled

queries.description: Sběr dat - aktuální školní rok u škol
queries.sqlStatement: WITH T AS( SELECT CONCAT('[', value) AS VAL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY value) AS ORD FROM STRING_SPLIT( CAST ( ( SELECT TOP 1 dalsi3 FROM bkparam) AS nvarchar(MAX) ), '[' ) WHERE value <> '' ), S AS ( SELECT LEFT(VAL, CHARINDEX(']', VAL)) AS SECTION, SUBSTRING( VAL, CHARINDEX(']', VAL) + 3, LEN(VAL) - CHARINDEX(']', VAL) ) AS K FROM T ), Parsed AS ( SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM( LEFT( value, IIF(CHARINDEX('=', value) > 0, CHARINDEX('=', value), 1) - 1 ) )) AS [Key], LTRIM(RTRIM( SUBSTRING( value, IIF(CHARINDEX('=', value) > 0, CHARINDEX('=', value), -1) + 1, 1000 ) )) AS [Value] FROM S CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(K, CHAR(13), ''), CHAR(10)) WHERE SECTION IN ('[Default]') AND LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) <> '' AND CHARINDEX('=', value) > 0 ) SELECT CONVERT(varchar, CAST(GETDATE() AS date), 126) AS SampleDate, MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'AKT_ROK' THEN [Value] END) AS [Year], MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'AKT_POL' THEN [Value] END) AS [Semester] FROM Parsed WHERE [Key] IN ('AKT_ROK', 'AKT_POL')
queries.columnsNames: SampleDate, Year, Semester

queries.columnsNames: SampleDate, SchoolYear, ModuleId

queries.sqlStatement: SET NOCOUNT ON; IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.bakmodule', N'BAKMODULE_ID') IS NOT NULL BEGIN     DECLARE @ConstraintName sysname;     DECLARE @SQL nvarchar(MAX);     SELECT @ConstraintName = kc.name     FROM sys.key_constraints kc     INNER JOIN sys.index_columns ic         ON kc.parent_object_id = ic.object_id         AND kc.unique_index_id = ic.index_id     INNER JOIN sys.columns c         ON ic.object_id = c.object_id         AND ic.column_id = c.column_id     WHERE kc.parent_object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.bakmodule')       AND kc.type = 'PK'       AND c.name = N'BAKMODULE_ID';     IF @ConstraintName IS NOT NULL     BEGIN         SET @SQL = N'ALTER TABLE dbo.bakmodule DROP CONSTRAINT '                  + QUOTENAME(@ConstraintName);         EXEC sys.sp_executesql @SQL;     END     ALTER TABLE dbo.bakmodule         DROP COLUMN BAKMODULE_ID; END; select 1
